consequence.statement: These Helm options still work in 1.17.0 but are deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
consequence.remediation: Move the TLS certificates and keys into Secrets and point to them with the associated existingSecret options (e.g. hubble.tls.server.existingSecret, hubble.relay.tls.client.existingSecret, hubble.relay.tls.server.existingSecret, hubble.ui.tls.client.existingSecret).

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0, eight Hubble TLS cert/key Helm options (hubble.tls.server.cert/key, hubble.relay.tls.client.cert/key, hubble.relay.tls.server.cert/key, hubble.ui.tls.client.cert/key) are deprecated in favor of the associated existingSecret options and will be removed in a future release.

decision.reason: [ev-672c6336b39c] says the eight Hubble TLS cert/key Helm options "have been deprecated in favor of the associated `existingSecret` options and will be removed in a future release." Nothing in it says they stop working or are ignored in 1.17.0, so the right kind is deprecation (review), not a failure kind. The remediation's example existingSecret paths are inferred from "associated existingSecret options" and marked "e.g.". They are not a separate claim.
